XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn. Llŷr Powell.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much. Llŷr Powell.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Lywydd. Trefnydd, may I ask for a statement from the Cabinet Minister for Rural Resilience and Sustainability on historic PCB dumping in Wales? In my own constituency, toxic waste was dumped in the Ty Llwyd quarry in Ynysddu, and, decades later, there's no formal determination that the site is contaminated land, and nothing has been published on the long-term plan, despite the fact that PCBs have been found on the site.

Last week, Michael Sheen told Parliament that the First Minister didn't take him up on his offer, but I know that Members here would be grateful if the Government could provide us with an opportunity to find out what plan the Welsh Government has for dealing with toxic waste dumping across Wales, because constituents of all of us have been living with this for too long now.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Lywydd. Drefnydd, a gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Wydnwch Gwledig a Chynaliadwyedd ar ddympio PCB yn hanesyddol yng Nghymru? Yn fy etholaeth i fy hun, fe gafodd gwastraff gwenwynig ei ollwng yn chwarel Tŷ Llwyd yn Ynysddu ac nid oes penderfyniad ffurfiol wedi pennu bod y safle yn dir halogedig, ddegawdau yn ddiweddarach, ac nid oes unrhyw beth wedi cael ei gyhoeddi ar gynllun hirdymor, er gwaethaf y ffaith bod PCBs wedi cael eu darganfod ar y safle.

Yr wythnos diwethaf, fe ddywedodd Michael Sheen wrth y Senedd nad oedd y Prif Weinidog wedi derbyn ei gynnig ef, ond fe wn i y byddai'r Aelodau yma yn ddiolchgar pe byddai'r Llywodraeth yn gallu estyn cyfle i ni ddarganfod pa gynllun sydd gan Lywodraeth Cymru ar gyfer ymdrin â dympio gwastraff gwenwynig ledled Cymru, oherwydd mae etholwyr pob un ohonom ni wedi bod yn byw gyda hyn am lawer yn rhy hir bellach.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Gaf i ddiolch i'r Aelod am godi'r mater pwysig hwn? Mi ddylwn i ddatgan fy mod i, ers blynyddoedd lawer, wedi bod yn ymwneud efo etholwyr yn fy etholaeth i ar y mater hwn, ac yn parhau i wneud hynny fel Aelod unigol. Dwi'n siŵr bod pawb ohonom ni a welodd y rhaglen ddogfen Buried, os nad oeddech chi'n ymwybodol o hyn o'r blaen, wedi cael eich syfrdanu gan effaith hwn. Ac yn sicr, fel y clywsoch chi'r Prif Weinidog yn dweud yn gynharach, o ran Michael Sheen hefyd, mi fydd yna drafodaethau pellach yn digwydd. Ond mae hon yn broblem sydd wedi bod yn wybyddus, a nifer o bobl wedi bod yn ymgyrchu am flynyddoedd lawer. Mae'n bwysig ein bod ni fel Llywodraeth yn mynd i'r afael â hyn, a dwi'n falch o allu cadarnhau ei fod o'n flaenoriaeth i ni. Mi ydyn ni rŵan yn mynd ati i ddatblygu strategaeth ledled Cymru i adfer tir ôl-ddiwydiannol yn raddol, fel nad yw cymunedau bellach yn agored i risgiau posib. Ac mi fyddwn i'n gofyn i bob Aelod sydd efo enghreifftiau yn eu hetholaethau nhw i fod yn rhan o'r gwaith hwnnw efo ni.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: May I thank the Member for raising this important issue? I should state that I, for many years, have been involved with constituents in my own constituency in dealing with this issue, and I continue to do that as an individual Member. I'm sure that each and every one of us who saw that documentary, Buried, if they weren't aware of this previously, will have been shocked by the impact that this has had. And certainly, as you heard the First Minister stating earlier, in terms of Michael Sheen too, there will be further discussions happening. But this is a problem that has been known for a while and many people have been campaigning for many years. It is important that we as a Government do tackle and address this issue, and I'm pleased to be able to confirm that it is a priority of ours. We are now developing a pan-Wales strategy to restore post-industrial land, so that communities no longer face those possible risks. And I would ask every Member who has examples in their own constituency to become involved in that work with us.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Prynhawn da, Weinidog. Can I thank the Cabinet Minister for Rural Resilience and Sustainability for the statement he issued during recess on the issue I raised previously regarding pollution in the River Tawe? Constituents continue to contact me, raising concerns regarding the need to tackle pollution in our rivers, seas and lakes. I would therefore be grateful if the Minister would provide us with an update on the creation of the new Welsh water regulator, in giving Wales greater control over how our water and natural resources are managed and regulated. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Prynhawn da, Weinidog. A gaf i ddiolch i'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Wydnwch Gwledig a Chynaliadwyedd am y datganiad a gyhoeddodd ef yn ystod y toriad ar y mater a godais i'n flaenorol o ran llygredd yn Afon Tawe? Mae etholwyr yn cysylltu â mi o hyn, yn codi pryderon ynghylch yr angen i fynd i'r afael â llygredd yn ein hafonydd, ein moroedd a'n llynnoedd. Fe fyddwn i'n ddiolchgar felly pe bai'r Gweinidog yn rhoi'r wybodaeth ddiweddaraf i ni ar greu rheoleiddiwr dŵr newydd i Gymru, gan roi mwy o reolaeth i Gymru ar sut y bydd ein dyfroedd a'n hadnoddau naturiol yn cael eu rheoli a'u rheoleiddio. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi pwnc sydd yn bwysig iawn i nifer o'n hetholwyr ni ac i nifer o Aelodau yma. Mi fyddwn i'n hoffi atgoffa'r holl Aelodau bod y Papur Gwyrdd, 'Shaping the Future of Water Governance in Wales', sy'n ymateb i argymhellion a wnaed gan y Comisiwn Dŵr Annibynnol, bellach, a'r ymgynghoriad hwnnw, wedi dod i ben. Mi gyhoeddwyd crynodeb o'r ymatebion ar 14 Medi, felly yn ddiweddar iawn. Rydyn ni'n ystyried y dystiolaeth a'r farn a dderbyniwyd yn ofalus cyn gwneud penderfyniadau ar gam nesaf y diwygio. Ein nod wrth gwrs ydy sicrhau fframwaith rheoleiddio sy'n cyd-fynd â blaenoriaethau Cymru, yn cryfhau atebolrwydd ac yn cefnogi canlyniadau gwell i gwsmeriaid, cymunedau a'r amgylchedd. Mi fyddwn ni wrth gwrs yn diweddaru holl Aelodau'r Senedd hon wrth i'r gwaith hwnnw fynd rhagddo.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising an issue that's very important for many of our constituents and for many Members here. I would like to remind all Members that the Green Paper, 'Shaping the Future of Water Governance in Wales', which responds to recommendations made by the Independent Water Commission, has now, and that consultation, concluded. A summary of responses was published on 14 September, so very recently. We are considering the evidence and the views expressed carefully before making a decision on the next step of reform. Our aim, of course, is to ensure a regulatory framework that complies with the requirements of Wales, strengthens accountability and supports better outcomes for customers, communities and the environment. We will of course update all Senedd Members as that work proceeds.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, can I ask for a statement from the Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy on the funding of the Jobs Growth Wales+ programme? I've been made aware of some significant funding pressures in the programme, affecting, in particular, year 11 school leavers. Now, while this is part of the employability policies, it is part of the landscape of post-16 education and training. I know you'll agree with me that it's absolutely crucial that we support all young people to prevent them from becoming NEET—not in education, employment or training. I would welcome a statement from the Cabinet Minister setting out the funding position and details of any pressures. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, a gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad gan y Gweinidog Menter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni ar ariannu rhaglen Twf Swyddi Cymru? Rwyf i wedi cael gwybod am bwysau ariannol sylweddol ar y rhaglen, sy'n effeithio, yn benodol, ar rai ym mlwyddyn 11 sy'n gadael yr ysgol. Nawr, er bod hyn yn rhan o'r polisïau cyflogadwyedd, mae'n rhan o dirwedd addysg a hyfforddiant wedi 16 oed. Fe wn i y byddwch chi'n cytuno â mi ei bod yn gwbl hanfodol ein bod ni'n cefnogi pob unigolyn ifanc i'w atal rhag mynd yn NEET—heb fod mewn addysg, cyflogaeth na hyfforddiant. Fe fyddwn i'n croesawu datganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet yn nodi'r sefyllfa ariannol a manylion unrhyw bwysau. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn. Yn amlwg, mae'r hyn y mae'r Aelod wedi ei godi yn fater sydd yn cael ei drafod yn gyson gan y Cabinet. Mae hwn yn flaenoriaeth i bawb ohonom ni fel Aelodau etholedig, gobeithio. Yn sicr, mi wnaf i wneud y Gweinidog Cabinet yn ymwybodol o'ch cais chi. Mi fyddwn ni wrth gwrs yn diweddaru'r Senedd o ran y gwaith hwnnw sy'n mynd rhagddo hefyd.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much. Evidently, what the Member raised is an issue that is discussed regularly by the Cabinet. This is a priority for all of us as elected Members, I would hope. Certainly, I will make the Cabinet Minister aware of your request. We will of course be updating the Senedd in terms of the work that's proceeding as well.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I'd like to call for a statement from the Cabinet Minister for Education and the Welsh Language on education provision in mid Wales in light of the release of the latest Programme for International Student Assessment results. These results should be a wake-up call for the Welsh Government. Wales is the worst-performing nation in reading, mathematics and science, and, this year, Welsh pupils fell even further behind their peers across the UK and internationally. Those national failures are reflected locally, with Estyn judging Powys County Council's education services to be causing significant concern. While confidence in state education is declining, Labour's VAT raid on private schools has forced the closure of seven Welsh independent schools in the past year alone, driving a further divide and an increase in education inequality. Since the Welsh Government's election in May, there's been very little action on state education. So, when will the Government change course? Can the Minister commit to prioritising a genuinely results-driven approach, where success is measured by whether Welsh children are actually achieving better outcomes?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fe hoffwn i alw am ddatganiad gan Weinidog y Cabinet dros Addysg a'r Gymraeg ar ddarpariaeth addysg yn y canolbarth yng ngoleuni cyhoeddi canlyniadau diweddaraf y Rhaglen Ryngwladol Asesu Myfyrwyr. Fe ddylai'r canlyniadau hyn fod yn agoriad llygad i Lywodraeth Cymru. Cymru yw'r genedl sy'n perfformio waethaf o ran darllen, mathemateg a gwyddoniaeth ac, eleni, fe syrthiodd disgyblion Cymru hyd yn oed ymhellach y tu ôl i'w cyfoedion ledled y DU ac yn rhyngwladol. Mae'r methiannau hynny drwy'r wlad yn cael eu hadlewyrchu yn lleol, gydag Estyn yn barnu bod gwasanaethau addysg Cyngor Sir Powys yn achosi pryder sylweddol. Er bod yr hyder yn addysg y wladwriaeth yn dirywio, mae ymosodiad TAW gan y Blaid Lafur ar ysgolion preifat wedi gorfodi cau saith ysgol annibynnol yng Nghymru yn y flwyddyn ddiwethaf yn unig, sy'n achosi ymraniad pellach a chynnydd mewn anghydraddoldeb addysg. Ers etholiad Llywodraeth Cymru ym mis Mai, ychydig iawn o weithredu sydd wedi bod o ran addysg y wladwriaeth. Felly, pryd fydd y Llywodraeth yn newid ei chwrs? A all y Gweinidog ymrwymo i flaenoriaethu dull sydd wir yn cael ei ysgogi gan ganlyniadau, lle mae llwyddiant yn cael ei fesur ar y sail bod plant Cymru wir yn cyflawni canlyniadau gwell?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r mater hwn. Wn i ddim a oeddech chi yn y Siambr ar gyfer clywed ymatebion y Prif Weinidog ac a ydych chi wedi cael cyfle i weld bod yna ddatganiad yn hwyrach y prynhawn yma gan y Gweinidog sydd â chyfrifoldeb dros addysg o ran cyhoeddi'r cynllun llythrennedd a rhifedd sylfaenol. Dwi'n credu oedd sylwadau'r Prif Weinidog yn ddiamwys o ran sut rydyn ni'n ystyried y canlyniadau hyn, ac wrth gwrs mi fyddwn i'n annog i unrhyw Aelod, os oes yna bethau penodol o fewn eich etholaeth chi sydd yn creu pryder ichi, gysylltu efo'r Gweinidog dros addysg yn uniongyrchol.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising this issue. I don't know whether you were in the Chamber to hear the First Minister's response and have had an opportunity to see that there is a statement later this afternoon by the Minister with responsibility for education on the publication of the foundational literacy and numeracy plan. I think that the First Minister's statements were unambiguous about this how we consider these results, and, of course, I would encourage every Member, if there are specific issues within your constituency that are causing you concern, to engage with the Minister for education directly.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, I'd like to request a statement from the Welsh Government on the availability of non-emergency hospital transport. I've received significant representations from constituents over the summer who have been left without transport to take them to important hospital appointments. Now, some of my constituents have had their transport cancelled at very short notice and, as a result, they've had to spend a small fortune on taxis to get them to their appointments. Now, some of these constituents, as you can imagine, are elderly, with limited mobility and little support. And, as I'm sure you can imagine, these cancellations have left many patients frustrated, anxious, and, quite frankly, this is not how the Welsh NHS should be operating in the twenty-first century. Therefore, I'd be grateful if we could have a statement from the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care on the performance of patient transport across Wales so that we can understand what the Welsh Government is doing to improve this vital service.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, fe hoffwn i ofyn am ddatganiad gan Lywodraeth Cymru ar argaeledd cludiant i ysbytai heb fod mewn argyfwng. Rwyf wedi derbyn sylwadau sylweddol dros yr haf gan etholwyr sydd wedi cael eu gadael heb gludiant i fynd â nhw i apwyntiadau pwysig mewn ysbytai. Nawr, mae rhai o'm hetholwyr i wedi gweld eu cludiant yn cael ei ganslo ar rybudd byr iawn ac, o ganlyniad i hynny, maen nhw wedi gorfod gwario ffortiwn ar dacsis i gadw eu hapwyntiadau. Nawr, mae rhai o'r etholwyr hyn, fel rydych chi'n gallu ei ddychmygu, yn oedrannus, gyda chyfyngiadau ar eu symudedd ac ychydig iawn o gefnogaeth. Ac, fel rwy'n siŵr y gallwch chi ei ddychmygu, mae'r achosion hyn o ganslo wedi achosi rhwystredigaeth a phryder i lawer o gleifion ac, i fod yn onest, nid fel hyn y dylai GIG Cymru fod yn gweithredu yn yr unfed ganrif ar hugain. Felly, fe fyddwn i'n ddiolchgar pe caem ni ddatganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal ar sut y mae cludiant cleifion yn gweithio ledled Cymru er mwyn i ni ddeall beth mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn ei wneud i wella'r gwasanaeth hanfodol hwn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Wel, gaf i ddiolch ichi fel Aelod am godi'r mater pwysig hwn? Mae'n ddrwg calon gen i glywed am yr effaith hynny ar etholwyr. Rydyn ni hefyd yn gwybod beth mae hynny'n ei olygu o ran apwyntiadau wedi eu methu, efo nifer o bobl yn gorfod aros amser maith am apwyntiadau o'r fath. Yn sicr mi wnaf i'r Gweinidog yn ymwybodol o'r hyn rydych chi wedi ei godi heddiw. Dwi'n gobeithio, os oes gennych chi esiamplau penodol hefyd, eich bod chi'n codi'r rheini efo'r bwrdd iechyd yn uniongyrchol, ac yn sicr efo'r Gweinidog hefyd. Felly, mi fyddaf i'n bwydo hynny nôl iddo fo yn dilyn y sesiwn hon.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Well, may I thank you as a Member for raising this important issue? I'm terribly sorry to hear about that impact on your constituents. We're also aware of what that means in terms of missed appointments, with many people having to wait a long time for such appointments. Certainly, I will make the Minister aware of what you've raised this afternoon. I do hope that, if you do have specific examples too, that you raise those with the health board directly, and certainly with the Minister too. So I will feed that back to him following this session.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Fel y cyfeiriwyd eisoes, byddwch chi'n ymwybodol, wrth gwrs, y darlledwyd y rhaglen ddogfen Buried yn ystod yr haf yn edrych i mewn i honiadau o gladdu PCBs, cemegau gwenwynig sydd ddim yn torri i lawr ond sy'n adeiladu i fyny yn yr amgylchedd, anifeiliaid, pysgod a phobl dros amser. Claddwyd y cemegau hyn mewn o leiaf 12 safle yng Nghymru, gan gynnwys ger Rhiwabon, Cefn Mawr a phwll tocsig Llwyneinion, ger Rhos, sy'n safle erchyll, a dweud y lleiaf. Honnwyd bod cwmni cemegion Monsanto, a gynhyrchodd 98 y cant o'r holl PCBs yn y Deyrnas Gyfunol, wedi dympio, gan ddyfynnu,

'llawer iawn o gemegion diwydiannol o gwmpas Cymru'.

Mae hwn yn esiampl o'r gwaethaf o gorfforaethau mawr rhyngwladol yn rheibio ein cymunedau er budd eu hunain. Yng ngwyneb hyn oll, a all y Gweinidog rhannu datganiad efo ni maes o law ynghylch y sefyllfa anfoddhaol hon?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
As has already been referred to, you'll be aware that a documentary titled Buried was broadcast over the summer, looking into allegations around the burying of PCBs, toxic chemicals that don't break down but build up in the environment, animals, fish and people over time. These chemicals were buried in at least 12 sites in Wales, including near Ruabon, Cefn Mawr and the Llwyneinion toxic lagoon near Rhos, which is a terrible site, to say the least. It claimed that the chemical company Monsanto, which produced 98 per cent of all PCBs in the UK, dumped, and I quote,

'huge amounts of industrial chemicals all around Wales'.

This is one of the worst examples of large international corporations taking advantage of our communities. In light of this, could the Minister share a statement with us about this unsatisfactory situation?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Wel, diolch ichi am godi hyn. Mae'r ffaith mai chi yw'r ail Aelod i godi hwn yn dangos faint o bryder sydd. Mae'n ffaith bod arolwg awdurdodau lleol a gynhaliwyd gan Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru wedi nodi yn 2015 fod mwy na 9,000 o safleoedd posib sydd angen eu hymchwilio ymhellach. Er na fydd pob un o'r safleoedd hyn yn peri risg i iechyd pobl neu'r amgylchedd, mae'r ffigur hwn yn dangos maint y broblem sy'n wynebu rheoleiddwyr yng Nghymru. Fel y clywsoch chi'n gynharach, mae mynd i'r afael â thir halogedig yn flaenoriaeth allweddol i'r Llywodraeth hon, ac mi fyddwn ni'n mynd ati i ddatblygu strategaeth ledled Cymru i adfer tir ôl-ddiwydiannol fel nad yw cymunedau yn agored i risgiau posibl. Mi fyddwn ni hefyd, fel y gwnes i ymestyn allan i Llŷr Powell yn gynharach, yn gofyn ichi a phob Aelod arall sydd yn pryderu am hyn i gydweithio efo ni fel Llywodraeth.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Well, thank you for raising this. The fact that you're the second Member to do so does demonstrate how much concern there is. A local authority survey held by NRW noted in 2015 that there were over 9,000 possible sites that need further investigation. Although not every one of those sites poses a risk to human health or the environment, this figure does show the scale of the problem facing regulators in Wales. As you heard earlier, tackling contaminated land is a key priority of this Government, and we will be developing a pan-Wales strategy to restore post-industrial land so that communities aren't facing possible risks. We, as I also reached out to Llŷr Powell, would ask you and every other Member that is concerned about this issue to work with us as a Government.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, I would like to call for a Welsh Government statement that clearly outlines how it will balance its renewable energy objectives. Parts of my constituency are deeply affected by large-scale windfarm developments. I have written questions on this issue and I note your manifesto commitment for undergrounding. I wish to put on record my constituents' huge ongoing concerns about the visual and economic impact of wind turbines. The impact of extensive windfarm developments on Wales's natural landscape could be potentially catastrophic. As part of that statement, will the Government also include a comprehensive impact statement examining the economic, environmental and social consequences of planned wind energy developments across Wales? Such an assessment would help provide transparency on the long-term implications for rural communities, tourism and energy infrastructure. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, fe hoffwn i alw am ddatganiad gan Lywodraeth Cymru i amlinellu yn eglur sut y bydd hi'n cydbwyso ei hamcanion o ran ynni adnewyddadwy. Mae datblygiadau ffermydd gwynt ar raddfa fawr yn effeithio llawer iawn ar rannau o'm hetholaeth i. Rwyf wedi ysgrifennu cwestiynau ar y pwnc hwn ac rwy'n nodi eich ymrwymiad maniffesto ar gyfer tanddaearu. Fe hoffwn gofnodi pryderon enfawr parhaus fy etholwyr i o ran effaith weledol ac economaidd tyrbinau gwynt. Fe allai effaith datblygiadau ffermydd gwynt eang fod yn drychinebus ar dirwedd naturiol Cymru. Yn rhan o'r datganiad hwnnw, a wnaiff y Llywodraeth gynnwys datganiad cynhwysfawr hefyd yn ymchwilio i ganlyniadau economaidd, amgylcheddol a chymdeithasol datblygiadau ynni gwynt arfaethedig ledled Cymru? Fe fyddai asesiad o'r fath yn helpu i gynnig tryloywder o ran y goblygiadau hirdymor i gymunedau cefn gwlad, twristiaeth a seilwaith ynni. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Mi fydd yr Aelod wedi clywed datganiadau blaenorol gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Fenter, Cysylltedd ac Ynni. Wrth i'r gwaith fynd rhagddo, wrth gwrs, mi fydd yna ddiweddariadau i'r Senedd a chyfle i Aelodau graffu a rhoi mewnbwn pellach.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: The Member will have heard previous statements by the Cabinet Minister for Enterprise, Connectivity and Energy. As the work proceeds, there will, of course, be further updates to the Senedd and an opportunity for Members to scrutinise and provide further input on the matter.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Prynhawn da, Drefnydd. I'd like to request a statement, please, on the future of community hospital services in Powys. Earlier this month, Powys Teaching Health Board published proposals confirming the scale of change that's now on the table. Hospitals from Ystradgynlais to Llandrindod Wells could lose their in-patient beds entirely, leaving Powys with as few as 60 physical health beds across just two hospitals. Minor injury units and x-ray services would also disappear from several sites. You cannot plan healthcare for Powys as though we were in an urban area with another hospital only 10 minutes away. Geography matters for our population, which is ageing, as well. Families' ability to reach loved ones also matters, particularly those needing palliative care. There's also a serious question about the consultation itself, with the option of protecting our existing network of community hospitals discounted before residents even had a chance to respond. May I ask you what the Welsh Government would do to intervene and stop these proposals? Diolch yn fawr iawn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Prynhawn da, Drefnydd. Fe hoffwn i ofyn am ddatganiad, os gwelwch chi'n dda, ar ddyfodol gwasanaethau ysbytai cymunedol ym Mhowys. Yn gynharach y mis hwn, cyhoeddodd Bwrdd Iechyd Addysgu Powys gynigion yn cadarnhau graddfa'r newid sydd yn yr arfaeth erbyn hyn. Fe allai ysbytai o Ystradgynlais i Landrindod golli eu gwelyau cleifion mewnol yn gyfan gwbl, a fyddai'n gadael Powys gyda chyn lleied â 60 o welyau iechyd ffisegol ar draws dim ond dau ysbyty. Fe fyddai unedau mân anafiadau a gwasanaethau pelydr-x hefyd yn diflannu ar sawl safle. Ni allwch gynllunio gofal iechyd ar gyfer Powys i gyd fel pe byddem ni mewn ardal drefol gydag ysbyty arall ddim ond 10 munud i ffwrdd. Mae daearyddiaeth yn ystyriaeth bwysig i'n poblogaeth ni, sy'n heneiddio hefyd. Mae gallu teuluoedd i gyrraedd at anwyliaid yn bwysig hefyd, yn enwedig y rhai sydd angen gofal lliniarol. Mae cwestiwn difrifol hefyd o ran yr ymgynghoriad ei hun, gyda'r dewis o ddiogelu ein rhwydwaith presennol o ysbytai cymunedol yn cael ei ddiystyru cyn i breswylwyr gael cyfle i ymateb. A gaf i ofyn i chi beth fyddai Llywodraeth Cymru yn ei wneud i ymyrryd ac atal y cynigion hyn? Diolch yn fawr iawn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r mater hwn. Mae'n bwysig nodi nad ydy'r bwrdd iechyd wedi gwneud unrhyw benderfyniad ar ei gynllun gwasanaethau clinigol. Maen nhw'n dal i ddatblygu'r cynllun hwn ac opsiynau posib, cyn ymgynghoriad arfaethedig yn ddiweddarach eleni. Felly, fe fyddwn i'n gobeithio bod y pwyntiau hynny wedi cael eu codi gyda'r bwrdd iechyd yn uniongyrchol hefyd. Fel gydag unrhyw newid gwasanaeth neu ddatblygu strategaeth, mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn disgwyl i fyrddau iechyd ymgysylltu â phobl yn agored ac yn dryloyw ac yn unol â chanllawiau cenedlaethol. Mae Llywodraeth Cymru hefyd yn disgwyl i'r bwrdd iechyd wneud unrhyw benderfyniad yn seiliedig ar dystiolaeth, wedi'i ategu gan arfarniad opsiynau cadarn ac asesiadau effaith i sicrhau bod dyfodol y gwasanaethau hyn yn gynaliadwy, yn addas i ddiben, sef y pwynt roeddech chi'n ei wneud, ac yn ddiogel i'r boblogaeth leol. O ystyried bod y gwaith hwn yn mynd rhagddo ar y funud, mi fyddai'n amhriodol i mi wneud sylw pellach.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising this issue. It's important to note that the health board hasn't made any decision on its clinical services plan. They are still developing that plan and possible options, before a proposed consultation later this year. So, I would hope that those points have been raised directly with the health board too. As with any change in services or strategy development, the Welsh Government expects health boards to engage openly with people in a transparent manner, in accordance with national guidance. The Welsh Government also expects the health board to make any decision based on evidence, supported by a robust options evaluation and impact assessments to ensure that the future of these services is sustainable, fit for purpose, which is the point that you made, and safe for the local population. Given that this work is ongoing at the moment, it would be inappropriate for me to comment further.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: We've already heard about historic dumping from my colleagues here today. I want to ask the Trefnydd for a statement about ongoing illegal waste dumping taking place across Fflint Wrecsam. Unlawful waste dumping has been taking place in at least 16 sites across the constituency, centred on locations in and around Coedpoeth. Natural Resources Wales has the powers, under section 59 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990, to address unlawful waste disposal and require remediation. However, despite enforcement action reportedly being taken by NRW to date, residents remain deeply concerned about the situation and about the apparent lack of progress in halting the dumping and protecting the surrounding environment. How is the Welsh Government working with NRW to help tackle this issue and its impacts on local communities?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Rydym ni wedi clywed eisoes gan fy nghyd-Aelodau yma heddiw am ddympio hanesyddol. Rwyf eisiau gofyn i'r Trefnydd am ddatganiad ar ddympio gwastraff anghyfreithlon sy'n digwydd yn barhaus ar draws Fflint Wrecsam. Mae dympio gwastraff yn anghyfreithlon wedi bod yn digwydd ar 16 safle o leiaf ar draws yr etholaeth, gan ganolbwyntio ar leoliadau yng Nghoedpoeth a'r cyffiniau. Mae'r pwerau gan Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru, dan adran 59 o Ddeddf Diogelu'r Amgylchedd 1990, i fynd i'r afael â gwaredu gwastraff yn anghyfreithlon a gwneud adferiad yn ofynnol. Er hynny, er gwaethaf camau gorfodi a gymerodd CNC hyd yn hyn, mae trigolion yn parhau i bryderu yn ddirfawr am y sefyllfa ac am y diffyg cynnydd ymddangosol o ran atal y dympio a diogelu'r amgylchedd cyfagos. Sut bydd Llywodraeth Cymru yn gweithio gyda Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru i helpu i fynd i'r afael â'r mater hwn a'i effeithiau ar gymunedau lleol?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch am godi'r mater. Yn amlwg, rydych chi'n sôn am bethau sy'n digwydd rŵan, ac mi fyddaf i'n gwneud y Gweinidog Cabinet yn ymwybodol o'r sylwadau. Fe fyddwn i hefyd yn gofyn i chi ei wneud o'n ymwybodol o'r safleoedd hyn fel ein bod ni'n gallu ymchwilio ymhellach. Rydyn ni wedi bod yn pwyso am gyfiawnder amgylcheddol trwy godi'n uniongyrchol gyda'r Trysorlys ba mor bwysig ydy ceisio cyllid y Llywodraeth y Deyrnas Unedig i barhau â'n hymdrechion ar y cyd i fynd i'r afael ag etifeddiaeth gorffennol diwydiannol Cymru, gan gynnwys adfer tomenni glo ac adfer tir halogedig. Mae'n bwysig hefyd, wrth gwrs, fod awdurdodau lleol a Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru yn mynd ati efo'r rôl rheoleiddio hwnnw. Felly, mi fyddaf i'n mynd â hwn ymhellach efo'r Gweinidog. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you for raising this issue. You're talking about issues that are going on now, evidently, and I will make the Cabinet Minister aware of your comments. I'd also ask you to make him aware of these sites so that we can explore this issue further. We have been pressing for environmental justice by raising directly with the Treasury how important it is to have UK Government funding to strengthen our joint efforts to tackle the legacy of Wales's industrial heritage, including restoring coal tips and contaminated land. It's important also that local authorities and NRW do proceed with that regulatory role. So, I will take this further with the Minister. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, I'd like to bring forward a health statement from the Cabinet Minister for health on a similar issue to what Jane Dodds raised, actually, about what the Minister can do to intervene in Powys health board's plans to close hospitals and beds across our constituencies. We all know a consultation is not a referendum as well, and it does need to follow robust evidence. But one thing we hear time and time again is that Ministers cannot intervene directly in health boards. So, I'd be interested if the health Minister could bring forward a statement on how the law can be changed to give Welsh Ministers the powers to intervene directly in health boards. That's something I would support, and I'm sure a lot of my colleagues would do the same, so that Ministers are actually accountable for the things that they talk about in this Chamber and can't just pass the buck back to to the health board all the time. So, a statement on that would be very welcome.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, fe hoffwn i weld datganiad iechyd yn cael ei roi gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros iechyd ynglŷn â mater tebyg i'r hyn a gododd Jane Dodds, mewn gwirionedd, ynglŷn â'r hyn y gall y Gweinidog ei wneud i ymyrryd yng nghynlluniau bwrdd iechyd Powys i gau ysbytai a gwelyau ar draws ein hetholaethau ni. Fe wyddom ni i gyd nad yw ymgynghoriad yn refferendwm hefyd, ac mae angen iddo ddilyn tystiolaeth gadarn. Ond un peth y byddwn ni'n ei glywed dro ar ôl tro yw na all Gweinidogion ymyrryd yn uniongyrchol yn y byrddau iechyd. Felly, fe fyddwn i'n falch iawn pe byddai'r Gweinidog iechyd yn cyflwyno datganiad ar sut y gellir newid y gyfraith i roi pwerau i Weinidogion Cymru ymyrryd yn uniongyrchol yn y byrddau iechyd. Mae hynny'n rhywbeth y byddwn i'n ei gefnogi, ac rwy'n siŵr y byddai llawer o'm cydweithwyr yn gwneud yr un peth, fel bod Gweinidogion yn atebol am y pethau y maen nhw'n siarad amdanyn nhw yn y Siambr hon ac nad ydyn nhw'n gallu taflu'r baich yn ôl at y bwrdd iechyd drwy'r amser. Felly, fe fyddai croeso mawr i ddatganiad ar hynny.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Wel, diolch i chi am godi'r mater yna. Wn i ddim a ydych chi wedi codi hynny'n uniongyrchol efo'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal fel llefarydd, o ran y pwnc. Dwi'n gwybod bod y Gweinidog yn awyddus i gwrdd gyda rhai o bob plaid, a byddwn i yn eich annog chi i gael y trafodaethau uniongyrchol hynny. O ran yr hyn sy'n digwydd rŵan ym Mhowys, mi fyddwch chi wedi nodi fy ymateb i i Jane Dodds yn flaenorol. Ond o ran yr hyn sy'n gallu digwydd i'r dyfodol, dwi'n credu bod honna'n drafodaeth bellach i Aelodau ei chael, ac my fyddaf i hefyd yn gwneud y Gweindog Cabinet yn ymwybodol eich bod chi wedi codi hyn brynhawn yma.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Well, thank you for raising that issue. I don't know if you have raised that directly with the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care, as the spokesperson, in relation to this issue. I know that the Minister is eager to be meeting with Members of all parties and I would encourage you to have those direct discussions. In terms of what is happening now in Powys, you will have noted my response to Jane Dodds earlier. But in terms of what can happen for the future, I think that is a further discussion for Members to be having, and I will also make the Cabinet Minister aware of the issues that you've raised this afternoon.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, you will be aware that 21 October will mark 60 years since the Aberfan disaster, in which 144 people were killed, including 116 children. It was incredibly moving to be at the launch of a new photographic exhibition to mark this anniversary at Cyfarthfa museum last week, and it was good to see you there also. The Aberfan disaster rocked the communities that we represent and, as the first major disaster seen through the lens of a television camera, it truly reverberated around the world. The depth of the grief felt by the bereaved and the psychological burden borne by survivors is something that is impossible for us to truly comprehend in this Senedd. But I believe that this Senedd needs to pay tribute to the dignity and strength of the community, which has been so apparent as the people of Aberfan have come together to make arrangements to mark this sixtieth anniversary. So, Trefnydd, I'd like to ask for a debate in Government time to mark the significance of this event.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, rydych chi'n siŵr o fod yn ymwybodol y byddwn ni'n nodi 60 mlynedd ers trychineb Aberfan ar 21 Hydref, pan gafodd 144 o bobl eu lladd, yn cynnwys 116 o blant. Roedd hi'n arbennig o drawiadol i mi fod yn lansiad arddangosfa newydd o ffotograffau i nodi hyn yn amgueddfa Cyfarthfa'r wythnos diwethaf, ac roedd hi'n braf iawn eich gweld chi yno hefyd. Fe wnaeth trychineb Aberfan siglo'r cymunedau yr ydym ni'n eu cynrychioli ac, fel trychineb fawr gyntaf a welwyd drwy lens camera teledu, fe atseiniodd drwy'r byd mewn gwirionedd. Mae dyfnder y galar a deimlwyd gan y galarwyr a'r baich seicolegol a ddioddefodd y goroeswyr yn rhywbeth sy'n amhosibl i ni ei ddeall yn y Senedd hon. Ond rwyf i o'r farn bod angen i'r Senedd hon roi teyrnged i urddas a chryfder y gymuned, sydd wedi bod mor amlwg wrth i bobl Aberfan ddod at ei gilydd i wneud trefniadau i nodi'r trigain mlynedd a fu ers hynny. Felly, Drefnydd, fe hoffwn i ofyn am ddadl yn amser y Llywodraeth i nodi arwyddocâd y digwyddiad hwn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Well, thank you, Vikki, for raising such an important issue. Aberfan, as you say, is a name of a place that people know internationally for all those devastating reasons that you've outlined there. We share a constituency and, as you noted, I was at that launch with you to meet survivors of that tragedy, but also to meet parents who lost children that day who remain with us today. It's important that we remember that long-lasting impact on communities that will be felt for generations to come. In terms of the sixtieth anniversary, I know that we as a Government will take that time to reflect and we do intend to bring a statement forward at that time.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Wel, diolch i chi, Vikki, am godi mater mor bwysig. Mae Aberfan, fel rydych chi'n dweud, yn enw lle y mae pobl yn ei adnabod yn rhyngwladol am yr holl resymau dinistriol hynny y gwnaethoch chi eu hamlinellu yn y fan yna. Rydym ni'n rhannu etholaeth ac, fel roeddech chi'n ei nodi, roeddwn innau yn y lansiad hwnnw gyda chi i gwrdd â goroeswyr y drychineb honno, ond i gwrdd hefyd â rhieni a gollodd eu plant ar y diwrnod hwnnw ac sy'n dal i fod gyda ni heddiw. Mae hi'n bwysig ein bod ni'n cofio effaith hirdymor y drychineb ar gymunedau ac a fydd yn cael ei theimlo am genedlaethau i ddod. O ran y trigain mlynedd, fe wn i y byddwn ni yn y Llywodraeth yn defnyddio'r achlysur hwnnw i fyfyrio ac rydym ni'n bwriadu cyflwyno datganiad ar yr adeg honno.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I requested a statement on support for businesses that could be facing the loss of a professional rugby region. The Minister's answer to my written question confirms that the Welsh Government has undertaken no assessment of the economic or community impact, which I find surprising. The justification: the WRU is independent. That does not release this Government from its responsibility to the Welsh economy, businesses and hospitality sector. What is the Government offering the pubs, cafes, hotels and suppliers who stand to lose revenue? They have not bothered to assess the potential damage to local businesses, but perhaps the failure of Plaid's budget and the quest for independence have proved too much of a distraction. The Government did ask the WRU to consider the consequences, but this seems an inept response from an administration that is responsible for the Welsh economy. When will this Government undertake an impact assessment and explain what support businesses can expect, dependent on the final decision? These businesses deserve preparation and leadership. It seems this administration offers neither. Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fe ofynnais i am ddatganiad ar gefnogaeth i fusnesau a allai fod yn wynebu colli rhanbarth rygbi proffesiynol. Mae ateb y Gweinidog i'm cwestiwn ysgrifenedig yn cadarnhau nad yw Llywodraeth Cymru wedi ymgymryd ag unrhyw asesiad o ddylanwad economaidd a chymunedol hynny, rhywbeth yr wyf i'n ei gael yn syfrdanol. Y cyfiawnhad: mae URC yn annibynnol. Nid yw hynny'n rhyddhau'r llywodraeth hon o'i chyfrifoldeb i economi Cymru, y busnesau a'r sector lletygarwch. Beth y mae'r Llywodraeth yn ei gynnig i'r tafarndai, y caffis, y gwestai a'r cyflenwyr sy'n mynd i golli refeniw? Nid yw hi wedi mynd i'r drafferth i asesu'r difrod posibl i fusnesau lleol, ond efallai fod methiant cyllideb Plaid Cymru a'r ymchwil am annibyniaeth wedi tynnu gormod o sylw. Fe ofynnodd y Llywodraeth i URC ystyried y canlyniadau, ond mae hi'n ymddangos mai ymateb di-glem yw hwnnw gan weinyddiaeth sy'n gyfrifol am economi Cymru. Pryd fydd y Llywodraeth hon yn ymgymryd ag asesiad effaith ac yn eglur pa gymorth y gall busnesau ei ddisgwyl, yn ddibynnol ar y penderfyniad terfynol? Mae'r busnesau hyn yn haeddu paratoadau ac arweiniad. Mae'n ymddangos nad yw'r llywodraeth hon yn cynnig y naill na'r llall. Diolch i chi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Wel, mi fyddwn i yn tynnu sylw'r Aelod at y datganiad sydd yn dod yn hwyrach heddiw o ran y gefnogaeth sydd yna o ran business rates efo nifer o'r busnesau, ac ati, rydych chi wedi cyfeirio atyn nhw. Hefyd, wn i ddim a ydy'r Aelod ei hun yn gwybod beth ydy canlyniad adolygiad y WRU. Yn sicr, dwi ddim yn gwybod. O ran gwneud astudiaeth achos o'r fath, yn amlwg mae'r ddau gyngor sir wedi gwneud astudiaethau achos. Dwi wedi codi'r pryderon hynny'n uniongyrchol hynny efo'r WRU, sydd wedi mynegi i ni—. Mae gen i nifer o gwestiynau yfory ynglŷn â rygbi a dyfodol rygbi yng Nghymru, pan fyddaf yn cymryd cwestiynau fel Gweinidog Cabinet dros Ddiwylliant a Chwaraeon. Yn sicr, dwi'n credu bod unrhyw gyfarfod dwi wedi'i gael efo Undeb Rygbi Cymru wedi'i gadael nhw yn gyfan gwbl ddiamwys o gryfder y teimlad gan Aelodau yn y Senedd hon sy'n cynrychioli'r rhanbarthau hynny, o gryfder teimladau yn ein cymunedau ni, y pryderon gwirioneddol sydd yna o ran effaith economaidd, effaith o ran cydlyniad cymdeithasol—effaith o bob math. Felly, mae hynny wedi bod yn gyfan gwbl ddiamwys o ran yr hyn dwi wedi'i fynegi ac mae'r Llywodraeth hon wedi'i fynegi ar bob cyfle rydym ni wedi ei gael. Mi fyddaf i'n edrych ymlaen at ragor o gwestiynau yfory.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Well, I would draw the Member's attention to the statement that will be made later today in terms of the support as regards business rates for a number of the businesses, and so forth, that he referred to. I don't know whether the Member knows the result of the WRU's review. Certainly, I don't know. In terms of making a case study, clearly, the two local authorities have made case studies. I've raised those concerns directly with the WRU, which has conveyed to us—. I have a number of questions tomorrow about rugby and the future of rugby in Wales, when I take questions as Cabinet Minister for Culture and Sport. Certainly, I think that any meeting that I've had with the WRU has left them under no illusions about the strength of feeling among Members in this Senedd who represent those regions, and the strength of feeling in our communities, and the genuine concerns that exist about the economic impact and the impact in terms of social cohesion—impacts of all kinds. So, that has been unambiguous in terms of what I've conveyed and what this Government has conveyed at every opportunity we've had. I will look forward to having more questions on this tomorrow.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: I would like to request a statement from the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care on the high number of operations that are now being cancelled due to delays in patients passing the pre-operative assessment clinic assessments. This has been raised with me at a very senior level within the Betsi Cadwaladr health board. Clinicians are reporting that four to five operations a day are being cancelled in Ysbyty Glan Clwyd, despite being fully staffed, despite having the consultants there ready, waiting to do the operations. This means that a normal operating day that often runs from nine to five are seeing some surgeons finishing the day at 11 a.m. It has been noted that a main cause of the delay is due to staff sickness, but the real truth is that admin staff are not being able to book POAC appointments at present without having to go to senior management for an approval to book the POAC. This includes cancer surgery, which means now that cancer patients are waiting considerably longer for their operations that the consultants are wanting to do. At a time when waiting lists are high and there are promises from your Government to get those waiting lists down, will you ask the Cabinet Minister to make a statement on those claims that I've made here today to ensure that the delays that are currently in existence now are seen to and dealt with immediately? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Fe hoffwn i ofyn am ddatganiad gan Weinidog Iechyd a Gofal y Cabinet ar y nifer fawr o lawdriniaethau sy'n cael eu canslo oherwydd oediadau o ran cleifion sy'n pasio'r asesiadau clinigol asesu cyn eu llawdriniaeth. Fe godwyd hyn gyda mi ar lefel uchel iawn ar reolaeth bwrdd iechyd Betsi Cadwaladr. Mae clinigwyr yn adrodd bod pedair i bum llawdriniaeth y dydd yn cael eu canslo yn Ysbyty Glan Clwyd, er bod staff llawn yn bresennol ar eu cyfer, er bod yr ymgynghorwyr yno yn barod, ac yn aros i gyflawni'r llawdriniaethau. Mae hyn yn golygu bod diwrnod llawdriniaeth arferol sy'n aml yn rhedeg o naw i bump yn gweld rhai llawfeddygon yn gorffen y diwrnod am 11 a.m. Nodwyd mai un o achosion pennaf oediadau yw salwch staff, ond y gwir amdani yw nad yw staff gweinyddol yn gallu trefnu apwyntiadau Clinig Asesu Cyn Llawdriniaeth ar hyn o bryd heb orfod mynd at uwch reolwyr i geisio cymeradwyaeth ar gyfer archebu'r Clinig Asesu Cyn Llawdriniaeth. Mae hyn yn cynnwys llawdriniaethau canser, sy'n golygu bod cleifion canser yn aros yn sylweddol hwy bellach am eu llawdriniaethau nag y mae'r meddygol ymgynghorol yn awyddus i'w cael. Ar adeg pan fo rhestrau aros yn faith a phan addawodd eich Llywodraeth chi i fyrhau'r rhestrau aros hynny, a wnewch chi ofyn i'r Gweinidog Cabinet wneud datganiad ar yr honiadau yr wyf wedi eu gwneud yma heddiw i sicrhau y bydd yr oedi sy'n digwydd ar hyn o bryd yn cael sylw ac yn cael ei ddatrys ar unwaith? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Wel, dwi'n mawr obeithio bod yr Aelod wedi ysgrifennu at y Gweinidog Cabinet—
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Well, I very much hope that the Member has written to the Cabinet Minister—

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Ie, ac mae gennym ni ddwy iaith fan hyn, felly mi ydw i'n mynd i ddefnyddio'r Gymraeg i ymateb. Diolch. Ydy'r Aelod â'r cyfieithu yn gweithio rŵan?
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Yes, and we have two languages here, so I will use the Welsh language to reply to your question. Thank you. Is the interpretation working for the Member now?

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Grêt. Diolch yn fawr iawn. Dwi'n gobeithio bod yr Aelod wedi cymryd y cyfle i ysgrifennu at y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal, gan ddarparu'r dystiolaeth yr ydych chi wedi ei nodi fan hyn, a hefyd ddarparu'r dystiolaeth honno i'r bwrdd iechyd. Mae'n allweddol bwysig bod y wybodaeth yna gennym ni i ni fedru gweithredu, felly byddwn i yn gofyn eich bod chi yn gwneud hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Excellent. Thank you very much. I very much hope that the Member will have taken the opportunity to write to the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care, providing the evidence that she's outlined here this afternoon, and also providing that evidence to the health board. It's crucially important that that information is available to us so that we can act, so I would ask you to do that.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Drefnydd. I'd like to request a statement from the Deputy Minister for Transport following the deeply concerning rise in the number of people killed or seriously injured on Welsh roads. Now, every one of these statistics represents a person, a family, in some of those cases, a life tragically lost, so this deserves a serious response. Three years ago, the Welsh public were told that introducing a default 20 mph limit would make our roads safer, yet, last year, the number of people killed or seriously injured on our roads was the highest since before the pandemic. Now, this should force this Government to confront some difficult realities. Labour introduced this policy, Plaid Cymru backed it, millions of pounds of taxpayers' money has been spent implementing it, businesses and motorists have carried the consequences, yet these figures should concern every single one of us. Now there needs to be a proper assessment of what has worked, what has failed and, most importantly, what needs to change.

Trefnydd, residents across Wales deserve a road safety strategy based on evidence and results, not ideology. They deserve dangerous roads, junctions and accident black spots to be properly identified and tackled. They deserve investment, targeted where it will actually prevent serious accidents and save lives. And above all, they deserve honesty about whether the policy they were promised would make them safer is actually working. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Drefnydd. Fe hoffwn i ofyn am ddatganiad gan y Dirprwy Weinidog Trafnidiaeth yn dilyn y cynnydd pryderus iawn yn nifer y bobl sy'n cael eu lladd neu eu hanafu yn ddifrifol ar ffyrdd Cymru. Nawr, mae pob un o'r ystadegau hyn yn cynrychioli unigolyn, teulu, yn rhai o'r achosion hynny, bywyd a gollwyd yn drasig, felly mae hyn yn haeddu ymateb difrifol. Dair blynedd yn ôl, fe ddywedwyd wrth y cyhoedd yng Nghymru y byddai cyflwyno terfyn safonol o 20 mya yn gwneud ein ffyrdd ni'n fwy diogel, ond y llynedd, roedd cyfradd y bobl a laddwyd neu a anafwyd yn ddifrifol ar ein ffyrdd ar ei huchaf ers cyn y pandemig. Nawr, fe ddylai hyn orfodi'r Llywodraeth hon i wynebu sefyllfaoedd anodd. Y Blaid Lafur a gyflwynodd y polisi hwn, ac fe'i cefnogwyd gan Blaid Cymru, cafodd miliynau o bunnoedd o arian trethdalwyr eu gwario i'w roi ar waith, mae busnesau a modurwyr wedi cario'r canlyniadau, ond fe ddylai'r ffigurau hyn achosi gofid i bob un ohonom ni. Nawr mae angen asesiad priodol o'r hyn sydd wedi gweithio, yr hyn sydd wedi methu ac, yn bwysicaf oll, yr hyn y mae angen ei newid.

Drefnydd, mae trigolion ledled Cymru yn haeddu strategaeth diogelwch ar y ffyrdd sy'n seiliedig ar dystiolaeth a chanlyniadau, nid ideoleg. Maen nhw'n haeddu bod ffyrdd, cyffyrdd a'r mannau peryglus lle ceir llawer o ddamweiniau yn cael eu nodi a'u datrys yn briodol. Maen nhw'n haeddu buddsoddiad, wedi ei dargedu at atal damweiniau difrifol ac achub bywydau. Ac yn anad dim, maen nhw'n haeddu gonestrwydd o ran a yw'r polisi a addawyd iddyn nhw a fyddai'n eu gwneud yn fwy diogel yn gweithio mewn gwirionedd. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Can I be very clear that every death on our roads is a tragedy, and road safety remains a priority for this Government? I also would think that the Member would not wish to mislead the public, because the data does show that collisions were 22 per cent lower than in 2022, the most recent full calendar year before the change in default speed limits was implemented. There was a 2 per cent increase in 2024, but may I just emphasise this is the second lowest annual number recorded in Wales, with the lowest being in 2024?

We will always keep every policy under review. That is good government. But I think we also need to look at the statistics and be honest with people in terms of really understanding the impact of a policy over a longer term, which was always the case with this. But I would ask the Member to reflect on the actual data and what it stands for, and be careful in how we present that data.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
A gaf i fod yn glir iawn fod pob marwolaeth ar ein ffyrdd yn drasiedi, ac mae diogelwch ar y ffyrdd yn parhau i fod yn flaenoriaeth i'r Llywodraeth hon? Byddwn i hefyd yn meddwl na fyddai'r Aelod yn dymuno camarwain y cyhoedd, oherwydd mae'r data yn dangos bod nifer y gwrthdrawiadau 22 y cant yn is nag yn 2022, y flwyddyn galendr lawn ddiweddaraf cyn i'r newid yn y terfynau cyflymder diofyn gael ei weithredu. Bu cynnydd o 2 y cant yn 2024, ond a gaf i bwysleisio mai hwn yw'r ail nifer blynyddol isaf a gofnodwyd yng Nghymru, gyda'r isaf yn 2024?

Byddwn bob amser yn cadw pob polisi dan adolygiad. Llywodraethu da yw hynny. Ond rwy'n credu bod angen i ni hefyd edrych ar yr ystadegau a bod yn onest gyda phobl o ran deall effaith polisi dros y tymor hwy, a oedd bob amser yn wir o ran hyn. Ond byddwn yn gofyn i'r Aelod fyfyrio ar y data gwirioneddol a'r hyn y mae'n ei olygu, a bod yn ofalus wrth gyflwyno'r data hwnnw.
